entries.441b11ea1ec70fb2: An electronic components manufacturer that develops and manufactures electronic components such as connectors and microphones, and sells them to set makers in Japan and overseas.
entries.ab65374946d2e382: The company develops, manufactures and sells composite devices that fall under neither mechanical components nor acoustic components. The company also includes in this category what it previously called “display components.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,535 million (up 3.6% year on year), with sales for amusement-related applications increasing and sales for health equipment-related applications decreasing.
entries.b002398e97d5daa3: The company develops and manufactures mechanical components such as connectors, jacks and switches, and sells them to set manufacturers in Japan and overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥414,284 million (up 94.9% year on year), with sales for amusement-related and automotive-related applications increasing.
entries.cfe1c3abc603fc7e: The company develops, manufactures and sells acoustic components such as microphones, headphones, headsets, speakers and receivers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,431 million (down 7.5% year on year), as sales for automotive-related applications decreased.
